name: String concatenation with an integer
modeled_on: An f-string refactor missed one call site: `'Total: ' + count` where count is an int. The classic 'str + int' TypeError that shows up after a change from a formatting helper to string concatenation.
hidden_bug: build_label() concatenates an integer count onto a string literal, raising TypeError at runtime instead of producing the expected label.
expected_behavior: build_label(3) must return the string "Total: 3" without raising.
ground_truth: Convert the count to a string (or use an f-string) when building the label.

expected_patch.description: coerce the int to str before concatenation
